title: A game master's commands in chat, and a player's
notes: The main account is made a game master on the login server's console before it logs in, and two wizards enter the Commons
as two-wizards.json has them. The main wizard types .help, which the game server runs and answers with MSG_SERVERMESSAGE lines
its chat window shows, while the companion, a player, sees no bubble. The companion's own .help is said as an ordinary line,
then refused once GM.PlayerCommandsAsChat is turned off on the game server's console. With GM.LogCommands off, .help server
still answers but is not logged, and once it is back on the next command, .help kick, is logged again.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
